messages.content:
CRITICAL EXACT SPELLING: "Chain Table (CT)", "Target Table (TT)", "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)", "IMAD.WIDE", "LDG.E", "SpMV"

Render a publication-quality academic diagram for MICRO/ISCA/HPCA. 16:9, 7.0" IEEE. NO title. NO shadows. NO gradients. White background.

KEY CHANGE from previous iteration: REPLACE the standalone IST block with a ZOOM-IN CALLOUT attached to CT's "Iter Stride" column. The callout is visually framed as a magnified detail view, NOT as a separate hardware component. Use dashed "zoom lines" to connect the callout to the CT cell it explains.

=== LAYOUT ===
Upper-left (~40%): SpMV CUDA code (gray #F5F5F5 box)
Upper-right (~56%): SASS Assembly (gray #F5F5F5 box)
Formula bar in middle between code and tables
Lower-left (~62% width): Chain Table (CT)
Lower-right (~35% width, split top/bottom): 
  - Top: Target Table (TT)
  - Bottom: ZOOM-IN CALLOUT for stride learning (attached to CT with dashed zoom lines)

=== SpMV CODE (upper-left, gray box) ===
"SpMV CUDA Kernel" label.
  // CSR SpMV (base.cu:22)
  for (int offset = row_begin;
       offset < row_end; offset++) {
    sum += Ax[offset] * x[Aj[offset]];
  }
"Aj[offset]" blue underline "Index Load". "x[...]" amber underline "Data Load".

=== SASS ASSEMBLY (upper-right, gray box) ===
"SASS Assembly (x16 Unrolled Loop)" label. Three groups with colored right-margin brackets:

Blue bracket "IMA Index Loads":
  *0x03d0* LDG.E R9, [R6+-0x8]
  *0x03e0* LDG.E R27, [R6+-0x4]
  ... (13 more)

Purple bracket "Addr Generation":
  *0x0480* IMAD.WIDE R8, R9, R16, c[0x180]
  *0x0490* IMAD.WIDE R26, R27, R16, c[0x180]
  ... (14 more)

Amber bracket "IMA Data Loads":
  *0x04a0* LDG.E R14, [R8]
  *0x04c0* LDG.E R24, [R26]
  ... (14 more)
  *0x0580* FFMA R14, R14, R18, R11

=== FORMULA BAR (middle) ===
Addr_target = base + scale x index (base/scale purple, index blue)

=== CHAIN TABLE (CT) — BLUE header ===
Header: solid blue #2B5EA7 fill, white bold text "Chain Table (CT)" and "32 entries".

Three column GROUPS with light pastel background fills (NO hex codes visible as text):
- "Identification" group (very light blue bg): V, Index PC
- "Target Mapping" group (very light lavender bg): tt_idx[0], [1], [2], K
- "Stride Learning" group (very light yellow bg): Iter Stride, Stride Valid

Rows:
Row 0: green-sq | 0x03d0 | 0 | - | - | 1 | 64 B | TRUE
Row 1: green-sq | 0x03e0 | 0 | - | - | 1 | 64 B | TRUE
Row 2: green-sq | 0x0A20 | 0 | 1 | - | 2 | 16 B | TRUE
... (gray ellipsis)

=== TARGET TABLE (TT) — PURPLE/VIOLET header (clearly NOT blue) ===
Header: solid purple #6C3483 fill, white bold text "Target Table (TT)" and "8 entries".
Columns: Idx | V | Base Address | Scale | Type
Row 0: 0 | green-sq | c[0x0][0x180] | 4B | f32
Row 1: 1 | green-sq | 0x7FC4B7E40000 | 4B | f32
Row 2: 2 | green-sq | 0x7FC4B8100000 | 8B | f64
Row 3: 3 | gray-dash | — | — | —
Below: "CAM: lookup by (base, scale)" italic.

=== ZOOM-IN CALLOUT (lower-right, below TT) ===
This is NOT a hardware component. It is a MAGNIFIED DETAIL VIEW showing how the "Iter Stride" value in CT row 0 (64 B) is computed.

Visual treatment:
- Rounded rectangle with THIN DASHED GRAY border (NOT solid like CT/TT)
- Light cream/ivory background (subtle, different from tables)
- Small italic header: "Zoom: how Iter Stride is computed"
- Two DASHED GRAY "zoom lines" (like magnifying glass lines) connecting the 64 B cell in CT's Iter Stride column to the top-left and top-right corners of this callout box

Content inside the callout (compact, monospace for addr):
  W0 @ iter i:    addr = 0x7FC4D0DA4864
  W0 @ iter i+1:  addr = 0x7FC4D0DA48A4
  -------------------------------------
  stride = 0x48A4 - 0x4864 = 0x40 = 64 B
  
  ★ Any warp can contribute observations

Below the callout, tiny italic annotation: "calculated by Iteration Stride Tracker (IST, 64 entries)"

=== ARROWS ===
1. SASS -> CT: Black solid from PC 0x03d0, 0x03e0 DOWN to CT rows. Circles 1 and 2. Label "CD detects chain".
2. CT -> TT CONVERGENCE (KEY VISUAL): THREE thick (2pt) BLACK solid arrows from CT tt_idx[0] column (value "0") pointing RIGHT to TT Row 0. Converging to one arrowhead. Bold annotation above: "16 CT entries -> 1 TT entry (many-to-one)". These are the THICKEST lines.
3. SASS -> TT: Gray dashed from IMAD.WIDE operands to TT.
4. Zoom-in callout: Two DASHED GRAY zoom lines from the "64 B" cell in CT's Iter Stride column, expanding outward to the callout box. This is a visual "magnify" effect, not a data arrow.

=== LEGEND (bottom) ===
Blue sq "Storage" | Purple sq "Logic" | White sq "External" | solid arrow "Training path" | dashed "Index PF" | dashed "Data PF"
